body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Korea Electronics Show 2006 (KES 2006) kicks off at KINTEX(Korea International Exhibition Center) in Korea under the theme of ''Innovative Digital Solution'' from October 17 throughout 21. This year''s show is co-organized by MOCIE(Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Energy) and Gyeonggi Provincial Government with the management of KEA and KOTRA. The show ground is composed of 5 different pavilions covering different topics including digital information home appliances, information communication, industrial equipment, electronic components, and the products of China and Taiwan companies, and visitors can witness the cutting-edge technologies and various applications on the spot from the world''s largest 82-inch LED LCD TV to world''s first 102 PDPTV to 7-inch UMPC, and to 40nm 32GB NAND flash memory. This 5-day event expects to have more than 100,000 potential visitors and 6,000 foreign buyers with about 2.5-billion dollar trade deal.
